Delhi Man Abducts Boy, Drinks Poison During Police Chase

In Delhi, a man identified as a jilted lover abducted an 11-year-old boy, threatening to kill him unless the boy's sister married him. Police pursued the abductor for 22 kilometers. As officers closed in to arrest him, the man consumed poison and was subsequently hospitalized. The incident concluded with the boy's safe recovery.
